title.narrative: Activity under preparation HANGARIBIHE: Transformational climate-smart and inclusive agriculture in Rwanda

description.narrative: The action further consolidates the ongoing transition to a modern and climate-resilient rural transformation in Rwanda, key for the country to reach middle-income status by 2035.The Action will contribute to a climate-resilient, sustainable and inclusive agricultural transformation in Rwanda by continuing and consolidating the on-going EU innovative Climate Smart Agriculture package, providing support to areas not yet fully covered around climate action in agriculture (such as climate data for enhanced evidence-based agriculture sector policy making) and adjusting performance indicators to the new policy context -the new overarching national development strategy NST-2- and subsequent new sector policies in the areas of agriculture (PSTA 5[1]) and environment (Rwanda¿s NDC 3.0 formulation process is currently on going).The Action is a central element of the comprehensive ¿Investing in Sustainable and inclusive agricultural transformation¿ TEI, for investing in rural transformation, and encompasses the following closely interlinked elements: (i) institutional support to climate-smart agricultural transformation, value chain development and climate action (including building on climate-biodiversity-nutrition co-benefits) national policies, (ii) agricultural value chains development and (iii) public infrastructure investments. The Action builds on the reinforced capacity of relevant Government agriculture and environment agencies supported by previous EU interventions, in particular the on-going climate-smart agriculture budget support.In terms of impact, the Action intends to improve agricultural productivity, resource-efficiency and resilience through improved technology, climate smart practices and climate/biodiversity/nutrition co-benefits. The Action supports the Government¿s policies in the agriculture and environment and natural resources sector through a budget support with performance indicators on climate-smart agriculture and climate mitigation and adaptation measures. The Action also promotes private sector led production and value-chain modernisation. It encloses support to the Global Gateway Flagship ¿Kigali Wholesale Market (KWM)¿, a key transformative infrastructure supporting Rwanda¿s vision of becoming a regional distribution hub for fresh and processed food: it shall facilitate the commercialisation of agricultural produce, stabilise food prices, and favour producers and consumers and will strengthen Rwanda¿s agricultural value chains by centralising all types of fresh and nutritious produce (fruits, vegetables, flowers, meat, poultry, fish¿), improving logistics planning, quality control and storage of fresh produce. KWM encloses two main components: i) the large wholesaling infrastructure and ii) the value chain interventions, with Team Europe currently focusing on horticulture, fisheries and aquaculture.
